events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Barbarians at the Gate
events.text: [tribe] incursions have the military on high alert! Your advisors suggest that you muster additional Militia to secure the borders. However, supplies are low, and those resources may be better spent on building defenses.

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Frontier Wall

options.text: Build Fort to bring the fight to them.
We should spend our resources elsewhere.

events.text: The [tribe] have pillaged our lands, and the people are afraid. We should consider bolstering our defenses in [city].

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Great Migrations

options.text: Allow them in, on the condition they send their able fighters to enroll in the army.
Give them land within the city itself.
Let them settle on the outskirts of the city.
Turn them away from the city.

events.text: As the [tribe] appear on the horizon around [city], scared and vulnerable citizens grab what they can and flee the city. The fires that chase their shadows that night reassure that they made the right decision. However, it is not an easy path they are on, seeking a chance to rebuild their lives. One of these trails of desperate people are seeking refuge in [city]. Tired, hungry, and fearful of the [tribe] on their tail, they ask for passage into [rival]. Will the gates be opened?

events.author: Gabe Campbell
events.name: Insolent Tribesmen

options.text: Never fear [character]! We shall avenge this grave insult with your brave Warrior.
I admire your audacity [character], but we have enough men to handle these brigands.

events.text: Our city [city] has suffered a pillaged [improvement] Improvement at the hands of the barbarous [tribe]! [character], Oligarch of the [family], leading Family of [city], does not suffer such indignities lightly. He has come to you furious, and demanding revenge. [character] will be greatly pleased if you eliminate these insolent [tribe] outside of [city]. He has offered to recruit a band of local Warrior from [city] to help defend the city, but they will require funds for their equipment and upkeep.

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Pillaging Tribe
events.text: Warriors from the [tribe] tribe are said to be pillaging our lands! The people are terrified. How shall the court respond?

events.author: Gabe Campbell
events.name: Pillaging Tribesmen

options.text: We will see to it that you suffer no financial hardships from this devastation, [character].
I am surprised at you [character]! In times like these, we must all make sacrifices.

events.text: The lands outside the [family] city of [city] are being pillaged by the [tribe]! [character], Oligarch of the [family], leading Family of [city], does not suffer such indignities lightly. He has come to you furious that you have permitted such barbarous people to defile his territory, and is demanding compensation for your failure to protect [city]. Will you reach into the treasury to make [character] and the [family] whole again?

events.author: Gabe Campbell
events.name: Temple in Danger

options.text: We shall make quick work of these [tribe] with your brave Warrior Monks!
I admire your courage [character], but we have enough men to handle these brigands.

events.text: Our Holy [religion] city of [city] has suffered a pillaged [improvement] Improvement at the hands of the heretical [tribe]! [character], Head of [religion], is concerned for the safety of his in the <p.is_sub.S2=SUBJECT_CHRISTIANITY>Temple Christianity<p=SUBJECT_JUDAISM>Temple Judaism<p=SUBJECT_MANICHAEISM>Temple Manichaeism<else>Temple Zoroastrianism<end> nearby. As such, he is offering to recruit a band of local Warrior from the militant faithful of [city] to help defend the city, but they will require funds for their equipment and upkeep.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Price of War
events.text: The [tribe] forces have been raiding the lands around [city], leaving destruction and terror in their wake. The people grow fearful when they hear that riders have been seen approaching, but they stop short of the city. A lone warrior leaves their force and cautiously rides within earshot. The horde offer to work as mercenaries if you are able to pay. Otherwise they have little choice but to attack to survive. Will you accept this offer?
